messages.subject: Re: dyamic specification of variable name into ggvis/dplyr construction
messages.subject_clean: dyamic specification of variable name into ggvis/dplyr construction
messages.body_plain:
Hello Rob,
I am wondering if you were every able to come up with a solution to using the group_by function with an input string inside it.  I am attempting to make a ggvis plot using variable name inputs and would like to add a regression option.  I have been unable to use the group_by function within my application.  Depending on what I put inside the group_by(), I get an error saying "Error: is.broker(input) is not TRUE" or "Error: index out of bounds." Please see sample code below.  Any ideas would be greatly appreciated.  Thanks!
-Jesse

xvar <- input$x
yvar <- input$y
colorvar <- input$color
shapevar <- input$shape
sizevar <- input$size

xc <- prop ("x", as.symbol (xvar))
yc <- prop("y", as.symbol(yvar))
fillc <- prop("fill", as.symbol(colorvar))
shapec <- prop("shape", as.symbol(shapevar))
sizec <- prop ("size", as.symbol (sizevar))

df %>% ggvis(x=xc, y=yc) %>%
layer_points(fill= fillc, shape= shapec, size=sizec) %>%
group_by(as.name <http://as.name>(eval(colorvar))) %>%
layer_model_predictions(model = "lm")

messages.body_plain:
Hi Jesse,

There is now a standard-evaluation version of "group_by", called "group_by_". Would a formulation like this work for you?

df %>% ggvis(x=xc, y=yc) %>%
layer_points(fill= fillc, shape= shapec, size=sizec) %>%

group_by_(colorvar) %>%
layer_model_predictions(model = "lm")

I'm still a bit wobbly on the whole standard/non-standard evaluation thing, but it might be a place to start.

Ian

messages.subject_clean: add text layer on the mouse clik
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

I would like to know whether the following is possible. With add_tooltip I can show a tooltip when the pointer is near the data point. What I would like to do is to add permanent label instead of a tooltip. Ideally the label would be added with a click and removed if clicked for the second time.

Here is the example. This displays tooltip on hover:

mtcars$label <- rownames(mtcars)

all_values <- function(x) {
   if(is.null(x))return(NULL)
   x$label
}

base <-  mtcars %>% ggvis(x = ~wt, y = ~mpg, key:=~label) %>% layer_points()
base %>% add_tooltip(all_values,"hover")

This adds labels for all the points:

base %>% layer_text(text := ~label, align := "left", dx := 5)

I would like to add the labels conditional on a click.

Vaidotas

we can only tell when someone clicks on an existing graphical object,
not anywhere on the canvas.  We're aware that this is a problem, but
it might take a while before we can implement a fix.

messages.subject_clean: layer_points(): Is it possible to specify dot size by a factor variable?
messages.body_plain:
Hi Ying,

I'd suggest you include a scale_nominal() function in your pipe. In this case, you would be setting it for the "size" property - the domain is the set of your possible values, i.e. "No", "Yes" - the range would correspond to the minimum and maximum area (in pixels) of the symbol.

Ian
